user.title: FoxESS Battery Planner
user.description: Your FoxESS Cloud Open API key (foxesscloud.com > User Profile > API Management) and the inverter serial number. The key is stored in Home Assistant, not in any YAML file.

data_description.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Derived from the name if left empty.

sources.title: Battery and solar data
sources.description: Pick the sensors the planner reads. Add one forecast sensor per array if you have several; they are summed. Wh, kWh and MWh sensors are converted automatically. See docs/FORECAST_SOURCES.md for the supported integrations.

data.clear_sky_yield: Clear-sky yield (kWh per kWp per day)

data_description.weather_entity: Used only when no forecast sensor is readable. Estimates solar from cloud cover.
data_description.clear_sky_yield: Typical full-sun daily output per kWp. Around 4.5 is a cautious default.

schedule.title: Charge windows
schedule.description: Times when the battery may charge from the grid. Up to three windows; the planner works out one target for the night and applies it to every window, so charging stops once the target is reached. Windows must not overlap or cross midnight. The charge rate is a slider on the card (kW).

data.plan_lead_minutes: Plan this many minutes before the first window

error.invalid_auth: FoxESS rejected the API key or serial number.
error.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
error.need_forecast: Choose at least one forecast sensor, or a weather entity together with an array size.
error.window_order: Each window must end after it starts, on the same day.
error.window_incomplete: Give both a start and an end for each window you use.

abort.already_configured: This inverter is already set up.
